headline: Elvis Presley's estate sues Anthropic over AI training on his songs
summary: Authentic Brands Group, which owns Elvis Presley's music catalogue, is suing Anthropic, alleging the AI company used 274 of Presley's songs to train its models without permission.

claims.statement: Authentic Brands Group is suing Anthropic over the alleged use of 274 Elvis Presley songs to train AI models.
